You drive your fist toward the sentry’s jaw, but he blocks it with his forearm and absorbs the blow.

He grinds his stance, then shoves you back with a shoulder-check. His pilum comes up into guard, aimed toward your chest, while his gladius stays ready at his hip.

You drive a knee into the sentry’s ribs. His torso compresses, and he doubles over as the blow forces the breath out of him.
